blocks.label: Subject
blocks.body: A retired boxer taping his hands in a basement gym.

blocks.label: Style
blocks.body: Medium close-up, 85mm portrait, f/2.8. Softbox key camera-left. Kodak Portra 400, desaturated earth tones grade, palette: #0B3D2E deep green, warm brass, bone white.

blocks.label: Details
blocks.body: Rule of thirds, austere in feeling, in the register of Roger Deakins night exteriors.

blocks.label: Text
blocks.body: Render exactly: "NORTHBOUND SUPPLY CO". Correct spelling, high contrast, no other text anywhere in frame.

blocks.label: Constraints
blocks.body: Do not include logos, watermarks, other people. No watermarks, no signatures, no borders.

settings.name: size
settings.why: Asterisk, not x. 512 to 2048 per side

settings.name: prompt_extend
settings.why: Defaults true: turn it off for engineered prompts

notes: This is the model where a very long, layout-explicit prompt is the point. Describe every region and its contents.
Twelve languages natively, and it is the strongest option for dense Chinese text.
warnings: size uses an asterisk: 1024*1024, not 1024x1024. Silent-failure class bug.
prompt_extend defaults to true and will rewrite an engineered prompt. Turn it off.
prompt_extend_mode agent hard-fails with a 400 on image-to-image.

variations.name: Colder, more documentary
variations.text: Swap the grade for desaturated earth tones, drop to available light only, and shoot it on a 35mm at f/2.8. Same subject, no styling.

variations.name: Tighter and more graphic
variations.text: Go to an extreme close-up on the single most telling detail. Hard directional light, deep shadow, generous negative space around it.

variations.name: Wider, with context
variations.text: Pull back to an establishing wide. Put the subject small in the frame and let the setting carry the story. Keep the same light and grade.
